_comment: Real LAFD facility locations used as fixed dispatch depots in InfernoEnv,
one per resource type -- replaces the single made-up DEPOT_LONLAT used
before the helicopter/multi-depot upgrade. Coordinates were geocoded from
each station's official street address (LA County fire station locator /
lafd.org) via OSMnx/Nominatim, not estimated by eye.
Which station handles which resource type is OUR simplification for the
sim (one depot per resource type, matching the existing fixed-roster
'Clash Royale' mechanic) -- it is not a claim about that station's actual
apparatus roster, which we did not verify. What IS real: each station
name/address/coordinates, that it is an active LAFD facility, and that
its location plausibly covers the role assigned (e.g. Station 23 sits at
the immediate wildland-urban interface next to Topanga State Park, a
sensible staging point for a hand/trench crew cutting line ahead of a
wildfire; LAFD Air Operations is genuinely the department's one and only
helicopter base, at Van Nuys Airport).

depots.notes: Existing depot from the single-depot version of the env; kept as the water/engine depot. Coordinates re-geocoded from the station's official address (the prior DEPOT_LONLAT constant was an eyeballed approximation of this same station).

depots.address: 12229 W Sunset Blvd, Los Angeles (Brentwood), CA 90049
depots.notes: Covers the Brentwood/Bel-Air corridor along Sunset Blvd, east of the Palisades along the fire's likely spread direction.
Furthest station up-canyon toward Topanga State Park, closest to the wildland-urban interface where evacuation/rescue response is most needed.

depots.station_name: LAFD Station 114 / Air Operations (Van Nuys Airport)
depots.address: 16617 Arminta St, Los Angeles (Van Nuys), CA 91406
depots.notes: LAFD's actual sole helicopter base, on the grounds of Van Nuys Airport (KVNY) -- real fleet is 5 medium + 2 light helicopters shared department-wide. Deliberately outside the sim's bounding box (~19km north of the study area); travel time for this depot is straight-line distance / cruise speed, not road-graph routing, since it dispatches by air.
